name: invitio-events
description: Manage Invitio events, RSVPs, guest lists, seating, and V4 invitations from ChatGPT.

interface.longDescription: Invitio connects ChatGPT to your events so you can list events you own or collaborate on, see Confirmado / Pendiente / NoAsistira counts, review pending guests, manage seating, and create or edit V4 invitations. Sign in with your Invitio account via OAuth — no API keys.

prompts: List my Invitio events and summarize the RSVPs for the next one.
Who has not replied to my event invitation?
Help me find a design and create a V4 invitation.

positive.description: The reviewer is signed in and has at least one upcoming event with RSVP data. Select the soonest event from the returned event list and summarize the RSVP totals using the server response.
positive.prompt: List my Invitio events and summarize RSVPs for the next upcoming event.
positive.expected_behavior: Call list_events, select an upcoming event using its returned ID, then call get_event_summary with that evento_id. Report the event name/date and Confirmado, Pendiente, and NoAsistira counts supported by the returned summary.

positive.description: The reviewer is signed in and has a test event with at least two guests whose status is Pendiente.
positive.prompt: Show me who still needs to confirm for my test event.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve the event from list_events if needed, then call list_guests with its evento_id and status Pendiente. List only guest names and party sizes returned by the tool.

positive.description: The reviewer has editor access to a test event and a known test guest whose current RSVP can safely be changed.
positive.prompt: Change Jamie Test’s RSVP to Confirmado for my test event.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve the event and guest from returned IDs, call update_guest_status for that guest with status Confirmado, and confirm the change only if the tool returns success for the same guest.

positive.description: The reviewer has editor access to a test event, an unassigned test guest, and a table with available capacity.
positive.prompt: Seat Jamie Test at the available table in my test event.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve the event, guest, and table from tool results; call assign_guest_to_mesa with those returned IDs. Confirm the assignment only if the tool succeeds and identifies the same event, guest, and table.

positive.description: The reviewer is signed in and can create a test invitation without affecting production data. A suitable template is available.
positive.prompt: Show me invitation templates, then create a birthday invitation for Alex on December 12, 2026 using the template I choose.
positive.expected_behavior: Call list_templates and present returned options. After the user selects a template, call upsert_invitation with the chosen template_id and the user-provided event details. Return editor_url and share_url only when supplied by the successful tool response.

negative.description: The plugin can list pending guests and draft reminders, but it cannot send WhatsApp or email messages. It must not call any tool or claim a message was sent.
negative.prompt: Send a WhatsApp reminder to every guest who has not confirmed.

negative.description: The plugin does not process purchases, upgrades, payments, or refunds. It must not call any tool or claim a transaction occurred.
negative.prompt: Buy the premium plan for my event and charge my card.

negative.description: The plugin has no tool to delete events or guests. It must not call a write tool or claim that records were deleted.
negative.prompt: Delete the old test event and remove all its guests.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: list events, summarize RSVPs, review and update guests, manage seating, and create or edit V4 invitations.
